rubric_items.reason: Changes the existing settings handler and reuses localDay and the injectable context clock; no new parts.
S-1 AC1-AC4 are met by adding today from localDay(clock(), timeZone) while other fields and /health stay as they are.
The one new field, today, has name, type, nullability, format and example on an endpoint correctly marked changed.
Claims check out against the code, but the effect on an existing exact-body test of /api/settings is not mentioned.
Trade-offs are given for the context clock, per-request computation and leaving the web type unchanged.
Short, clear and consistent between front matter and body.

findings.text: The design omits that an existing test asserts the exact /api/settings body with three fields. Adding today will fail it, so implement must update that assertion while keeping the old values.

cites.quote: The other response fields and the health handler stay as they are.

findings.suggested_fix: Note that api/test/auth.test.ts must expect the added today field, with the three existing values unchanged.
